have been living in this area for 9 years and have been going to the same GP for the same amount of time. I understand that everyone’s experience can be different, but personally, I have never had the slightest issue.

Whenever I’ve called for myself, my family, or my children, even if it wasn’t for the same day, I was always able to get an appointment at the earliest available time.

I recently learned that blood tests are no longer done at the GP but at the hospital instead – I believe this is a general change. I have always been welcomed kindly by the reception staff, and I want to sincerely thank the doctors. They always listen carefully, ask questions, and try to guide me in the best way.

Of course, there can be small things from time to time – for example, just yesterday we had to make a few changes to my prescription. But I completely understand that these things can happen due to how busy and exhausting the day can be. In the end, everything was sorted out, and I don't consider these a problem.

I’m genuinely very happy with the care I’ve received. I hope the staff are happy working there too. Thank you again to everyone at The Ross Practice for your help and your warm smiles.
